ff10_definition: first 10 collision-free nonempty candidates in final score-ranked pool; weak-only primary and weak+no-FC separately reported; available denominator when less than 10
bootstrap: resample scenes within seen/similar/novel strata; 10000 draws
PCR_geometry: c=t+R*[depth-0.002,+/-width/2,0]; official grid_sample align_corners=False border padding
PCR_risk: RA+RC+RS, per candidate before original label-mask and score weighting; no fitted coefficients
contact_proxy: mean normal opposition error at evaluator close_fingers contacts; diagnostic oracle, not deployable predictor
decision: HOLD for unchanged PCR transfer; physical information and cross-detector existence supported
